question: The 'Mahawat' term is associated with which season in North-West India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Winter rainfall**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term **'Mahawat'** refers to a specific phenomenon of **winter rainfall** in the **North-Western region of India**.
 
• This rainfall is caused by the **Western Disturbances**, which are extratropical storms originating from the **Mediterranean region**.
 
• It generally occurs during the months of **December to February**.
